ITA-9.6.188 yamakabandhaḥ यमकबन्धः
Twin bandage
A type of bandage applied to two adjacent wounds.

.35 yāmaḥ यामः
Time equivalent to approximately 3 hours
Time equal to 3.75 muhurta.

ITA-2.8.17 yāmyakāyaḥ याम्यकायः
Person with judicious, prompt temperament
The characteristics of person with a judicious, prompt temperament are doing the right things with tireless energy, fearlessness, a good and retentive memory, freedom from attachments and infatuations, and a lack of vanity and jealousy.
